name: Statue of Liberty
description: Iconic neoclassical colossal copper statue on Liberty Island in New York Harbor.

name: Piazza San Marco
description: Principal public square of Venice, directly exposed to Adriatic tides and sea-level rise.

name: Sydney Opera House
description: Multi-venue performing arts centre perched on Bennelong Point in Sydney Harbour.

name: Mont-Saint-Michel
description: Tidal island commune and medieval abbey in Normandy surrounded by immense tides.

name: Tower of London
description: Historic 11th-century castle on the north bank of the tidal River Thames.

name: Burj Khalifa
description: World's tallest building (828m) situated near the Arabian Gulf coast in Dubai.

name: Taj Mahal
description: Mughal marble mausoleum on the Yamuna river in Agra, safe from global sea rise.

name: Great Pyramids of Giza
description: Ancient wonder standing elevated on the Giza plateau above the Nile delta.

name: Acropolis of Athens
description: Ancient rocky citadel towering high above Athens with the Parthenon temple.

name: Golden Gate Bridge (Base)
description: Coastal suspension bridge anchorage linking San Francisco to Marin County.

name: Mount Everest
description: Earth's highest peak above sea level, completely impervious to sea-level fluctuations.

name: Dead Sea Shore

name: Saint Basil's Cathedral

name: Ahu Tongariki Moai
description: Largest ceremonial megalithic platform of Easter Island located near the ocean shore.

name: Pompeii Ruins

name: Petra Treasury

name: Palace of Westminster & Big Ben
description: Seat of the Parliament of the UK on the low-lying banks of the River Thames.

name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
description: Massive steel arch bridge spanning between Sydney CBD and the North Shore.

name: Marina Bay Sands
description: Iconic integrated resort on reclaimed coastal land facing Singapore's Marina Bay.

name: Palm Jumeirah

name: Citadel of Qaitbay (Pharos Site)
description: 15th-century maritime fortress on the Mediterranean, site of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria.

name: The Colosseum

name: Machu Picchu
description: Inca citadel set high on an Andean mountain ridge above the Sacred Valley.

name: Great Barrier Reef Coastal Gateway
description: Low-lying tropical coastal gateway to the world's most extensive coral reef system.

name: Everglades Coastal Base
description: Pristine subtropical mangrove wilderness at the southern tip of the Florida peninsula.

name: Giant's Causeway
description: Interlocking hexagonal basalt columns descending directly into the North Atlantic Ocean.

name: Galápagos Coast (Puerto Ayora)

name: Victoria Falls

name: Iguazu Falls
description: Massive semicircular waterfall system on the border of Argentina and Brazil.

description: 19th-century Romanesque Revival palace on a rugged hill in southwest Bavaria.

name: Alhambra Palace
description: Moorish palace and fortress complex overlooking the city of Granada.

name: Angkor Wat
description: Vast Khmer temple complex surrounded by extensive hydraulic reservoirs.

name: Eiffel Tower

name: St Mark's Campanile

name: Table Mountain

name: Cape of Good Hope

name: Gateway of India

name: Petronas Twin Towers
description: 88-story twin skyscrapers in Kuala Lumpur, safely inland above coastal waters.

name: Merlion Landmark

name: Ocean Drive Historic District
description: World-famous Art Deco thoroughfare directly bordering South Beach in Miami Beach.

name: Venice Lido Barrier Island
description: Crucial narrow sand barrier island shielding the Venetian Lagoon from Adriatic surges.

name: Rock of Gibraltar
description: Monolithic limestone promontory towering above the strategic Strait of Gibraltar.

name: Santa Monica Pier
description: Double-jointed historic amusement pier extending over the Pacific Ocean surf.

name: St. Peter's Basilica
description: Renaissance church in Vatican City, slightly elevated above the Tiber river.

name: Panama Canal Miraflores Locks
description: Key gravitational lock gates operating the inter-oceanic Panama transit corridor.

name: Ha Long Bay Karsts
description: Emerald waters and thousands of towering rainforest-topped limestone islands.

name: Mount Fuji (5th Station)
description: Japan's sacred volcanic peak, towering vastly above Suruga Bay.

name: Louvre Museum
description: World's most visited museum on the Right Bank of the Seine in central Paris.
